mapper.sql: select deposit_id, tenant_id, elder_id, elder_name, deposit_type, amount, pay_method, operator_id, operator_name, create_by, create_time, remark from biz_deposit
mapper.select:
where del_flag = '0'
and elder_name like concat('%', #{elderName}, '%')
and deposit_type = #{depositType}
order by deposit_id desc
select ifnull(sum(case when deposit_type = '1' then amount else -amount end), 0) from biz_deposit where elder_id = #{elderId} and del_flag = '0'
